## PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Nivin Xavier is a serial entrepreneur and data-driven digital marketing consultant based in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. He has been an entrepreneur since 8th grade and a digital marketer for over 15 years. He has built and led companies across digital consulting, AI-powered analytics, and manufacturing, working with clients from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 corporations across North America, Europe, India, and the Middle East.

He is known for combining deep analytical rigour with genuine creative instinct, a combination he developed over a career that spans content writing, SEO, paid media, digital transformation strategy, product management, team building, and entrepreneurship. He has personally written over 10 million words of researched content for clients across technology, health, finance, marketing, and analytics sectors.

## CURRENT VENTURES AND COMPANIES

### CGEC Canada
Role: Founder
Description: CGEC is Canada's not-for-profit council helping Canadian businesses launch and expand into the United Kingdom, European Economic Area, and India, backed by 13 years of EICBI's institutional relationships across parliamentary corridors. CGEC helps Canadian founders, SMEs, and enterprises navigate the regulatory, commercial, and cultural landscape of entering these markets.
Sector: Trade Facilitation, International Expansion, Non-Profit
Website: https://unlittered.com

### Omni Vue AI
Role: Founder
Description: An AI-powered omni-channel brand intelligence platform. Omni Vue AI empowers brands to track, analyse, benchmark, and amplify their brand exposure across social media, connected TV, traditional TV, OTT platforms, and news, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The platform is built to help brands understand their real-world media footprint and drive decisions with data.
Sector: Artificial Intelligence, Brand Analytics, SaaS, MarTech

### Atlantic Blinds
Role: Founder
Description: A premium window coverings brand serving residential and commercial clients in Atlantic Canada, specifically Halifax and surrounding areas. Built on quality manufacturing, white-glove installation, and strong B2B and B2C relationships.
Location: Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada
Sector: Manufacturing, Retail, B2B, B2C

### LifeSpace Blinds
Role: Founder (Built and Exited)
Description: Nivin's original entrepreneurial venture, started in 8th grade from his aunt's garage. A window blinds manufacturing business that served both B2B clients (large brands and distributors) and B2C customers. Successfully built and exited.
Sector: Manufacturing
